name: WHO-5
shortDescription: 5-item World Health Organization measure of positive mental well-being (higher is better).
timeframe: Over the last two weeks, how often have you felt the following:
citation: Topp CW, Østergaard SD, Søndergaard S, Bech P. Psychother Psychosom. 2015;84(3):167-176.

questions.text: I have felt cheerful and in good spirits
I have felt calm and relaxed
I have felt active and vigorous
I woke up feeling fresh and rested
My daily life has been filled with things that interest me

scoring.formulaDescription: Raw sum of 5 items (0–25) multiplied by 4 to yield a 0–100% positive well-being index. Scores of 50% or lower suggest poor well-being and warrant follow-up.
